admissions.structural_correspondence: PS2 allocates manager work160=28+11*12 and a12B pending queue; Golden216=40+11*16 and a16B pending queue. Both store the entries-manager identity, pending-list pointer and flags|1, reset the same16B message-window state with two -1 handles, mode/suspended zero and two enabled bytes, then register priority15 with the assist update callback. The paired callback activates queued messages, clears bit1 after drain and marks all11 slots for release. Steam32f510 independently allocates headers64 plus work216/16, stores the same fields, resets the same root-state sentinels and registers the same named task; startup also inlines this constructor. This compound queue/layout/callback graph proves the role, not name similarity.

admissions.structural_correspondence: Both field-root constructors clear the global field frame, allocate their controller work (PS2244B, Golden424B), register a priority15 child with update/destroy callbacks and save the returned handle globally. This rich branch/work protocol distinguishes the root from subordinate resource/setup tasks; newer extra field cases and camera implementation are not declared equivalent.
